_comment: Renewal Health (Lynette Wing, RN/HHP). Static site in seo-factory/renewal-health/_deploy, deployed via GitHub Pages (renewal-health-preview repo, renewalhealth.life). Publish dates come from the first commit that ADDED each file. Health/YMYL client: nothing in this dashboard may imply diagnose/treat/cure claims. Content cadence is 2 posts/week via the renewal-content-engine skill (Mon 7:40am).
